integrity.sequence: First recursively hashed all packet files without semantic interpretation. Read the already-hashed manifest to discover external input paths (its criteria were displayed at this stage). Then hashed and size-checked all 66 manifest/live-W/copy/proof/ROOT entries before reading candidate or source/proof semantics. Rehashed all 66 after semantic review; pre/post identical. Live files and ROOT were hashed, not semantically reread separately from their identical packet copies.

criteria.rationale: External per-row version separates physical format from arbitrary JSON output. V0 is always raw; SQL NULL is unknown absence, JSON null is a present value. V1 uses a four-key base64 JSONB envelope, canonical UTF-8, exact digest/byte equality, strict JSON domain, inclusive logical/physical/depth/node limits, and bounded SQL projection before driver parsing. This is a specified future implementation, not evidence of an existing codec.

Compatibility rests on exclusive schema/credential cutover, not a storage tag. The contract specifies a dedicated non-owner LOGIN with zero memberships, independently owned SECURITY INVOKER write guard with fixed principal/schema binding, deny-V1 expansion, old-session drainage and effective ACL/route revocation, original-query 42501 probes, mode-aware readiness before claim/model/body, and explicit unsupported mixed fleet. Existing hosts and consumers with direct SQL are not qualified by this review.

The future contract retains native transaction/fence lock order and tenant/proposal/attempt authority, requires atomic confirmation and same-attempt byte-identical idempotency, rejects different confirmations, prevents V0 adoption and uncertain retry, and preserves CONFIRMED on lost acknowledgement. It explicitly requires preserving the original confirm error if markUncertain also fails. The current source still needs changes to satisfy those future requirements; its state-equality shortcut and wrapper catch are not accepted as already correct.

Additive expansion defaults old rows to V0, initially denies V1 and forbids backfill/conversion/orphan adoption. Activation is quarantined until principal/schema/ACL/session/bin hashes and negative probes qualify. Lock and statement timeouts abort rather than retry. Rollback is prohibited after any V1 reservation or checkpoint2; the subsequent any-write rule resolves the earlier wording about these two irreversible compatibility boundaries. Roll-forward retains new readers/credentials; destructive down migration and replay after restore are forbidden. 0030 is only an observed candidate, not reserved.

J01-J16 specify rejectable positive/negative native-PG and public/process requirements, including old-reader permission denial, V0/orphan refusal, exact limits and corrupt encodings, transaction/ack/crash boundaries, concurrency, overflow, independent bound fences and recovery drills. J09 checkpoint crash and J10 pre-checkpoint journal crash are distinct. Every J case remains NOT_RUN. Provided historical logs substantiate a NUL failure and null recovery only; they do not substantiate any proposed DDL/codec/activation test.

Exact-SHA human T3 approval plus task/resource registration is mandatory before BUILD. Approval of immutable SPEC224 does not transfer. Trusted composition must opt in; workers/published/SDK/product are not silently enabled. Scope is a new disposable local synthetic resource; no actual data, clinical/financial/appointment actions, production, push/deploy/release or all-36-card parity is granted.

material_findings_omission: EMPTY: no material contract contradiction or rejectable underspecification identified in the bounded review.

implementation_obligations.text: Published kernel currently constructs a fence-only journal and independently SELECTs state,result for audit and close. V1 deliberately leaves result SQL NULL; those SQL consumers cannot infer decoded output. Do not admit this consumer on the strength of the adapter alone. Adapt and qualify its reads/wiring, or keep it excluded as the candidate already requires. J13 must use a genuinely bound native composition; no claim of published-host readiness is made here. This is not a material omission within the explicitly excluded-host scope.

Current code returns a same-state CONFIRMED row without comparing new result bytes and awaits markUncertain directly in the catch path. Future implementation must change these behaviors to meet the specified equality/conflict and error-preservation rules. Existing code or checkpoint tests do not prove those rules.
